english.meaning: to talk rubbish; to say whatever comes to mind
english.note: Slangy; 噏半個鐘廢話 means talk rubbish for half an hour.

exampleSentences.english: Hey, he’s incredibly snarky. He talks rubbish for half an hour before class even starts.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘿，寸到爆喇直情。佢上堂噏半個鐘廢話先喇。
